snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition is out now! Experience the genre-defining RTS with updated visuals, enhanced performance, four epic campaigns, nine iconic factions and over 100 maps – all in one game. 

The Definitive Edition will have a 30% Veteran’s discount for Anniversary Edition Owners on both STEAM and GOG. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556750/Warhammer_40000_Dawn_of_War__Definitive_Edition
